static_traits.name: 陈泰乐
static_traits.medical_history: not yet经历类似心理问题；not yet接受过心理治疗；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、配合度高，能具体描述情绪与事件；存在自我批评与Self-denial倾向

basic_info.main_problem: 我在饮食习惯not良和缺乏社交互动方面有困扰，尽管最近在工作上升职，但仍觉得自己是一个“反社会的失败者”。这些感受持续一段时间，但在升职后加剧，导致出现自我批评的想法，进一步自我隔离并怀疑自己的成就，把它们归因为负面特质而非努力。
basic_info.core_demands: Due to negative self-cognition after promotion, seeks help to cope with and improve these problems.

core_beliefs: 我是一个not合群的失败者
我not配获得成功，也not值得被认可

special_situations.event: Facing higher responsibilities and expectations after promotion
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能完美胜任或立即达到所有要求，就证明我not配、是失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 更努力工作但negate自身成就，将升职归因于运气或have not其他人可用
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not配被升职，这只是运气好或not人可用

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 在公开场合发言必须without懈可击，否则就会被嘲笑，说明我not适合领导
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to speak as little as possible in meetings, repeatedly replays and criticizes herself afterwards, and later avoids speaking in public settings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 所有人一定认为我很可笑

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果客户not高兴，一定是我做得很差，且会被投诉
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Apologizes excessively, eager to make amends to immediately eliminate negative feedback
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will complain about me; I messed things up

special_situations.event: Reflection自己的社交状况并自我隔离
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not善社交或not合群，就等同于失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 进一步Reduced socializing、与人保持距离以避免被评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我是一个not合群的失败者

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted, to be seen as a competent and trustworthy person
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate和嘲笑，担心暴露“not足”而失败
defense_goal: Keeps a low profile and avoids to reduce chances of being evaluated
Gains a sense of security and recognition through excessive effort

object_relations.self_representation: not配的“冒牌者”、随时可能失败的人
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔的评判者，会嘲笑与negate我的他人

manifestations: 升职后进一步自我隔离
outcomes: Worsening eating habits, declining body-mind state

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 认为同事“都把我当笑话”
将客户not满直接归因于自己not称职、认为对方会投诉自己

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: Avoids speaking in meetings, holds back expression
Turns outward expression and energy into inner self-harshness and rumination

positive_force: Engaged in work and competent (efforts earned the promotion)
Has motivation to change and actively seeks help
Able to notice and concretely describe negative automatic thoughts
negative_force: Self-denial、negate积极证据（negate升职的正面意义）
预测not yet来与灾难化倾向，对负面评价高度敏感
过度寻求外部评价与认可
not良饮食习惯影响身心状态与日常功能

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids speaking and taking on 'in the spotlight' tasks in work settings
antecedent: 升职后需要主持或领导会议
想到会被同事或上级评价时
面对高期待与新职责时
target_behavior.core_reason: 强烈的冒名顶替感与自我价值低、害怕被嘲笑和negate
target_behavior.function: 逃避被评价与潜在失败，短期缓解Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Productivity declines, hesitation and mistakes increase, forming a vicious cycle

antecedent: Reflection自己的社交状况或缺乏互动时
target_behavior.core_reason: 将自身贴上“反社会失败者”的标签导致羞耻与Self-denial
target_behavior.function: 避免尴尬与Being rejected，降低被评价风险
target_behavior.consequence: 支持系统薄弱、Loneliness感加重，进一步恶化情绪与功能

target_behavior.behavior: 面对客户not满时过度道歉、紧张、急于弥补
target_behavior.core_reason: 个人化与预测not yet来的认知，认为自己必然要被投诉、表现很差
target_behavior.function: Tries to quickly eliminate threats and gain external recognition
target_behavior.consequence: 显得更not自信，增加Self-doubt与紧张，影响后续表现

target_behavior.behavior: not健康饮食（回家后经常吃垃圾食品）
antecedent: 下班后疲惫、缺乏精力烹饪
target_behavior.core_reason: 精力not足与Low mood、缺乏计划，以食物进行短期情绪调节
target_behavior.consequence: Physical and mental state declines, affecting daily life and work performance
